cards.audioText: We still cannot retract the thrust reverser. Our approach speed will be higher than normal. Request vectors for the longest Runway.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们仍无法收回反推。进近速度将高于正常值。请求雷达引导至最长跑道。

cards.audioText: Our EGT continues to be above the maximum limit. Request descent. We might shut down engine Number Two shortly.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们排气温度继续高于最大限制，请求下降，我们可能马上关掉二发

cards.audioText: The engine vibration is now causing the airplane to shake violently. We are shutting down our engine Number Three.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在发动机抖振引起飞机震动剧烈，我们正关掉三发

cards.audioText: We’ve made a visual inspection of engine Number Two from the cabin. The engine cowling has fallen off.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们从客舱里目视观察了二发，其整流罩脱落了

cards.audioText: Ground vehicle has collided with our engine nacelle. Maintenance work is needed before flight. Request cancel our airway clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: 地面车辆撞到我们的发动机短舱。起飞前需要维修，请求取消航路许可。

cards.audioText: The Number Two engine has been shut down. We are no longer able to maintain level flight. Request descent to FL200.
cards.audioTextZh: 二发已关车，我们无法保持平飞，请求下降到高度层200

cards.audioText: The uncontained engine failure has caused parts of the fuselage to be damaged. Request emergency descent.
cards.audioTextZh: 发动机失效导致部分机身损坏，请求紧急下降

cards.audioText: There is a huge gaping hole in the aisle, somehow the cabin floor has been punctured. We are re-seating passengers. Request holding.
cards.audioTextZh: 客舱过道出现一个大洞，客舱地板不知为何被刺穿。我们正在重新安排旅客座位，请求等待。

cards.audioText: We have abnormal noise coming from the mid section of our fuselage, somewhere near the ceiling. Request descent and reduce speed.
cards.audioTextZh: 机身中段靠近天花板处有异常噪音。请求下降并减速。

cards.audioText: We are unsure about the cause of the explosion. There are injuries in the cabin. We’ll give you an update as soon as possible.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们不确定爆炸的原因，客舱有人受伤，我们尽快告知你们最新情况

cards.audioText: Some passengers have cuts and burn wounds due onboard explosion. Request diversion and medical services upon arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于机上爆炸，一些乘客有割伤和烧伤，请求备降，到场时需要医疗服务

cards.audioText: Ice is accumulating rapidly on the wings and fuselage. Request emergency descent to 6000 feet.
cards.audioTextZh: 冰快速积聚在机翼和机身上，请求紧急下降到 6000 英尺

cards.audioText: We had to descend immediately due to wind-shear at our cruise level. We didn’t have time to request descent as the frequency was busy.
cards.audioTextZh: 巡航高度遇到风切变，我们不得不立即下降，因为频率繁忙， 我们没有时间请求下降

cards.audioText: The airplane began to buffet when climbing through FL380. We had to stop climb immediately to increase airspeed.
cards.audioTextZh: 刚才爬升通过高度层380时飞机开始抖振，我们必须立即停止爬升以增加空速

cards.audioText: We are flying near our maximum altitude. We cannot maintain airspeed in this turbulence. Request immediate descent.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们接近最大高度飞行，遇到颠簸无法保持空速，请求马上下降。（4-5级）

cards.audioText: We encountered heavy rain and had a temporary flame out on our right engine. Request immediate climb.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们遇到大雨，右发暂时熄火，请求立即爬升

cards.audioText: We have stopped on Runway 23 and will remain on the runway due heavy fog. I say again, we are still on the runway.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们在跑道 23 停了下来，雾大，仍然在跑道上，我再说一遍，我们仍然在跑道上

cards.audioText: There is heavy drifting fog. We think it is no longer safe to taxi. Request to hold at present position.
cards.audioTextZh: 浓雾飘动，我们认为滑行不安全，请求原地等待

cards.audioText: Frontal weather is quickly moving in from the west. If the holding is more than 10 minutes, we will have to divert.
cards.audioTextZh: 锋面天气很快由西移动过来，如果等待超过10 分钟，我们将不得不备降

cards.audioText: There was temperature inversion when we descended through 3000 feet. Our airspeed dropped suddenly by 25 knots.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们下降通过 3000 英尺时有逆温层，我们空速突然掉了 25 节

cards.audioText: We performed the missed approach below the minimum because of advection fog. We could no longer see the runway lights.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于平流雾，我们执行了低于最低高度的复飞，我们不能再看见跑道灯了。（5-6 级）

cards.audioText: The latest weather says that frontal weather and freezing rain is now stationary over the airport. Request diversion.
cards.audioTextZh: 最新气象报说，锋面天气和冻雨正在机场上空停留，请求备降。（4-5级）

cards.audioText: We can’t find any gaps for at least 100 miles in the squall line covering our arrival route. Request diversion.
cards.audioTextZh: 飑线覆盖了我们进场航路，至少100海里范围内，我们都无法找到任何空间穿越，请求备降

cards.audioText: We can see dust swirls approaching the airport and we’re concerned about low level wind-shear. Request holding.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们能看到尘埃涡流接近机场，我们担心低空风切变，请求等待。（4-5级）

cards.audioText: The latest SIGMET says a super-cell thunderstorm is developing at our destination. Is our flight affected?
cards.audioTextZh: 最新SIGMET说，一个超级单体雷暴正在我们目的地机场形成，我们航班会受影响吗？

cards.audioText: Request to continue our flight. Our ETA is in two hours and maybe the airport will have the runways cleared of snow by then.
cards.audioTextZh: 请求继续飞行，我们预达时刻是2小时后，可能机场会在那时将跑道上的雪除干净

cards.audioText: We had to make a quick heading change due ice pellets. You didn’t answer our request so we squawked 7700 and made the heading change.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们因为冰丸必须快速改变航向。你没有回答我们的申请，因此我们设置应答机编码7700，并改变了航向

cards.audioText: We have just encountered a lightning strike. Some of our instruments have erroneous indications. Request diversion to the nearest suitable airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们刚遭受雷击，一些仪表出现错误显示，请求备降到最近合适机场（5-6级）

cards.audioText: We have had a lightning strike. So far no system seems to be affected. We will continue to our destination.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们遭遇雷击，至今没有系统受到影响，我们将继续飞往我们目的地

cards.audioText: Request to cancel our approach. Braking action is poor and we’re concerned about hydroplaning during rollout.
cards.audioTextZh: 请求取消进近。刹车效应差，我们担心着陆滑跑时发生水滑。

cards.audioText: We have received reports of freezing rain ranging from ground up to 5000 feet. Request diversion.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们收到了冻雨报告，范围从地面延伸到5000英尺，请求备降

cards.audioText: A sandstorm is forecast to reach the airport within 20 minutes. We won’t get airborne by then. Request cancel startup and tow back to the gate.
cards.audioTextZh: 预计沙暴在20 分钟内到达机场，我们到那时还不能升空，请求取消开车并拖回停机位。（5-6级）

cards.audioText: Heavy blowing snow is expected to last for another 30 minutes. Request to terminate approach and holding instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: 较大的风吹雪预计持续 30 分钟，请求终止进近、等待指令。（4-5级）

cards.audioText: Ice patches are covering the runway mostly along the runway edge. Uncontaminated runway width is about 30 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 跑道结冰区域主要覆盖在跑道边缘，未污染跑道宽度约30米。

cards.audioText: A dissipating thunderstorm is ahead of us. We are near the zero-degree isotherm. Request deviate an additional 10 miles to the right.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们前方有在消散的雷暴，我们接近零度等温线，请求再向右偏置10海里

cards.audioText: We have a visual on a tornado at our 10 o’clock, about 2 miles. Request immediate right turn.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们看到在 10 点钟方向，大约 2 海里处有龙卷风，请求立即右转

cards.audioText: The weather forecast says that the typhoon along our route will be intensifying. Request change our airway clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: 天气预报说我们航路的台风将会增强，请求改变我们的航路许可

cards.audioText: The hurricane has gathered in strength and will affect all airports at the south coast. Request diversion.
cards.audioTextZh: 飓风已大量聚集，而且将影响南海岸全部机场，请求备降

cards.audioText: We have entered volcanic ash. Our radios and engines are not working properly, now heading 235, and descending to FL 220, squawking 7700.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们已经进入火山灰，无线电和发动机都不能正常工作，当前航向235，下降到高度层220过程中，应答机编码7700。（5-6级）

cards.audioText: We are landing into the sun in heavy haze. Can you turn on the approach lights to maximum intensity?
cards.audioTextZh: 我们在严重霾中迎太阳着陆，能把进近灯调到最大强度吗？

cards.audioText: The follow-me vehicle is leading us to taxiway L3. Our wings will not clear the other airplanes on this narrow taxiway. We are stopping.
cards.audioTextZh: 引导车正引导我们到滑行道L3，在这条较窄的滑行道上我们的机翼无法避开其他飞机，我们停止滑行了

cards.audioText: We are stopping. The ground marshaller is still guiding us in, but I think my engine will hit the boarding bridge if we taxi any further.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们停下来了，地面引导员仍引导我们滑入，但我认为如果我们再滑入，我们的发动机将碰到廊桥

cards.audioText: We are shutting down our engines. There are boxes blown by the wind toward our aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们正关车，被风吹落的箱子向我们飞机袭来

cards.audioText: We had difficulty starting up our engines due strong tailwind. Request to change our pushback position facing west.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于强顺风，我们启动发动机困难，请求改变推出位置，机头朝西

cards.audioText: Another aircraft has collided with us. I’ll command an evacuation as soon as we both turn off our engines.
cards.audioTextZh: 另一架飞机与我们相撞，在我们双方都关车后，我将下令尽快撤离

cards.audioText: The tow bar has been bent. Our maintenance crew will inspect our nose wheel. Holding position.
cards.audioTextZh: 拖杆弯了，我们的机务人员将检查前轮，原地等待

cards.audioText: The tug has swung around and collided with our forward fuselage. We are shutting down engines. Request stairs vehicle and shuttle bus.
cards.audioTextZh: 拖车偏转撞到飞机前身，我们正关车，请求客梯车和摆渡车

cards.audioText: A catering truck collided with our aft fuselage. There are fumes in the cabin and we are quickly disembarking all passengers. Request fire services.
cards.audioTextZh: services. (5-6级)餐车撞到了我们的后机身。客舱有烟雾，我们正在尽快让所有乘客下机。请求消防服务

cards.audioText: The flaps were extended inadvertently and hit the fuel truck. We are disembarking all onboard personnel. Request fire services.
cards.audioTextZh: 襟翼无意中放出，碰到了油，。我们正在撤离机上所有人员，请求消防服务。(5-6级)

cards.audioText: Our airplane nose has now lifted off the ground due to improper load and balance. Request ground maintenance.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于不正确的配载平衡，飞机机头已经翘起，请求地面维护

cards.audioText: We have discovered leakage of dangerous goods in the cargo hold. Can you alert hazardous material specialists?
cards.audioTextZh: 我们已发现货舱里的危险品泄露，你们能通知危险品专家吗？（4-5级）

cards.audioText: The outer main landing gear might have rolled over runway lights when we made the one eighty turn. Request personnel to inspect.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们180 度转弯时主起落架可能擦到了跑道灯，请求人员检查。（4-5级）

cards.audioText: A passenger has assembled a bomb in the lavatory. He is making threats. Request emergency services.
cards.audioTextZh: 一名乘客已在厕所安装了一枚炸弹，他正在威胁我们，请求紧急服务

cards.audioText: We made a very hard landing. We’ll need maintenance inspection before our next flight. Suggest you check the runway touchdown zone.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们重着陆了，下次飞行前我们需要机务检查，建议你们检查跑道接地区

cards.audioText: I can read you, but I’m not sure you can hear me. I will squawk ident to comply with your instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: 我能听到你，但不确定你能否听到我。我将识别应答机以执行你的指令。

cards.audioText: I have heard an aircraft in distress but no one’s responding. I can help relay his message.
cards.audioTextZh: 我听到一架航空器遇险，但无人回应。我可以帮助转发其信息。

cards.audioText: Message relay: The aircraft in distress will ditch in the ocean. His present coordinate is One Eight Degrees, One Five Minutes, North, One Six Zero Degrees, Five Two Minutes East.
cards.audioTextZh: 转报：遇险飞机将海上迫降。目前坐标是18度15分北，160度52分东（6级）

cards.audioText: The aircraft in distress says he will attempt to force land in an area about ten miles Northeast of his position.
cards.audioTextZh: 遇险飞机说，他将尝试在其位置东北10海里区域迫降

cards.audioText: Request diversion. The latest weather at our destination suggests snow storm will last for 5 hours.
cards.audioTextZh: 请求备降，目的地机场最新天气表明，雪暴将持续5小时

cards.audioText: Our radar shows a strong echo from the thunderstorm ahead. Request immediate right turn to avoid it.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们雷达显示，前方有强烈雷暴回音，请求立即右转避开

cards.audioText: A passenger activated the overhead emergency oxygen generator. Request airport security on arrival to detain this individual.
cards.audioTextZh: 一名乘客触发了顶部紧急氧气发生器，请求机场保安到场拘留他

cards.audioText: We have a passenger with severe hyperventilation. He has received first aid but his condition is not improving. Request ambulance on arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: 一名旅客严重过度换气，已接受急救但情况未改善。请求落地后救护车到场。

cards.audioText: There was a fight onboard among a few passengers. One of them is now bleeding seriously. Request police and ambulances on arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: 几名乘客在机上打架，其中一个人流血严重，请求警察和救护车到场

cards.audioText: The purser told me the injured passenger has blood type O. Maybe this information is useful to the paramedics.
cards.audioTextZh: 乘务长告诉我伤员血型为O型。也许这个信息对医护人员有用。

cards.audioText: A passenger is unconscious after suffering from seizure. The cabin crew is giving her first aid. We will advise if we require a diversion.
cards.audioTextZh: 一名乘客癫痫发作，失去知觉，客舱人员正在急救。如需备降，我们将告知你们

cards.audioText: Many passengers and crew were injured due severe turbulence. We will advise the number and severity of injuries when able.
cards.audioTextZh: 因为严重颠簸，许多乘客和机组人员受伤，如果可以的话，我们将告知受伤人员和受伤程度

cards.audioText: An elderly passenger has passed away. We will continue to our destination. Request ambulance on arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: 一位年长的乘客去世了，我们将继续到目的地，请求救护车到场。（4-5级）

cards.audioText: We found a passenger unconscious from a drug overdose in the lavatory. Request police and ambulance on arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们发现一名乘客在洗手间服药过量失去意识，请求警察和救护车到场

cards.audioText: The sick passenger’s condition has improved. We no longer require the diversion. Request to continue to our destination.
cards.audioTextZh: 生病乘客的情况已经好转，我们不再要求备降，请求继续飞往目的地

cards.audioText: We received an emergency call from the cabin, but now nobody is responding. We can hear shouting and disturbance. Our cabin crew might be under duress.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们收到客舱紧急呼叫，但现在没人回应，我们能听见喊叫声和打斗声，客舱人员可能受到了胁迫。（5-6级）

cards.audioText: We can see two masked men with sharp weapons on our cockpit door surveillance camera. They are kicking the cockpit door.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们通过驾驶舱监控摄像机看见两个头戴面具，手拿利器的人，他们正在踢驾驶舱门。（5-6级）

cards.audioText: I can see the area outside of the cockpit. There are two hijack suspects standing in the aisle.
cards.audioTextZh: 我能看见驾驶舱外面区域，有两名劫机者正站在过道里

cards.audioText: One of the terrorists is about forty-year old. He is about 180 cm tall, wearing a brown shirt and dark pants.
cards.audioTextZh: 其中一名恐怖分子大约40 岁，他有180 厘米高，身穿棕色衬衫和深色裤子

cards.audioText: A terrorist is trying to access the cockpit. He is about 30 years old. He is wearing a hat and backpack.
cards.audioTextZh: 一名恐怖分子正试图接近驾驶舱，他大约30岁，头戴一顶帽子，背有双肩包

cards.audioText: The purser reports there are over ten hijackers onboard. They are threatening to kill passengers if we don’t fly to another destination.
cards.audioTextZh: 乘务长报告机上有超过10名劫机犯，他们正威胁我们，如果不飞往另一个目的地，他们就杀死乘客。（5-6级）

cards.audioText: We will remain on the runway. The hijackers have taken four hostages to the rear of the cabin.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们将停留在跑道上，劫机犯把四名人质带到了客舱后部

cards.audioText: We are unsure of our position due to navigation failure. If any station can hear me, please respond.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于导航故障，我们不确定当前位置。如任何电台能听到，请应答。

cards.audioText: We only have standby magnetic compass due instrument failure. Now heading 245. Request navigation assistance.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们仪表失效，只有备用磁罗盘，现在航向245，请求导航援助

cards.audioText: We are unsure of our position due FMS failure. Last known position five miles north of FUPAD, now heading 165 for weather avoidance.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于飞行管理系统失效，我们不确定当前位置，最后已知位置是PUPAD以北5海里，当前航向165以避开天气。（6级）

cards.audioText: A ramp inspection discovered crates of lithium batteries in the cargo hold. We are verifying. Request delay pushback.
cards.audioTextZh: 机坪检查发现货舱有数箱锂电池，我们正在核实，请求延迟推出。（4-5级）

cards.audioText: We had a smoke warning in the cargo hold. We have discharged the fire extinguisher. We are concerned about lithium batteries in that compartment.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们货舱有烟雾警告，已经释放灭火瓶，我们担心货舱里的锂电池（5-6级）

cards.audioText: Request passenger stairs connect immediately after we stop on the runway. We want to disembark passengers as quickly as possible.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们停止在跑道上后，请求立即连接客梯车，我们想尽快让乘客离机

cards.audioText: We nearly collided with that aircraft. We had very little vertical separation. Do you know the flight number of that aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh: 我们几乎与那架飞机相撞，我们之间几乎没有垂直间隔，你们知道那架飞机的航班号吗？

cards.audioText: We have about thirty injured persons on board, four are very serious. Can you deliver this message to the medical staff that are standing by?
cards.audioTextZh: 我们机上有三十人受伤，其中4 让人受伤严重，你能把此消息告知待命的医务人员吗？

cards.audioText: We are declaring minimum fuel. We will have less than 30 minutes endurance by the time we get to our destination.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们宣布最低燃油量，到达目的地机场时，我们燃油续航时间将少于30分钟

cards.audioText: We are declaring fuel emergency. Our endurance is 1 hour 58 minutes. We are 1 hour 30 minutes from the closest alternate airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们宣布燃油紧急状况，我们的续航时间是1小时58分钟，而我们到最近备降场时间是1小时30分钟

cards.audioText: We have been intercepted by a military aircraft. It is rocking its wings to indicate we should follow.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们被一架军用飞机拦截了，它摇动机翼让我们跟在（后边）

cards.audioText: I’m trying to identify the type and nationality of the military aircraft. So far, no response on 121.5.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们正试着识别军用飞机的机型和国籍。到目前为止，121.5频率仍没有回应

cards.audioText: We are heading 085. This heading allows us to quickly exit the prohibited airspace.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们航向085。这个航向能让我们快速离开禁区。

cards.audioText: If we continue to make orbits we will exceed our duty time limit by the time we land.
cards.audioTextZh: 如果继续盘旋，我们将在落地时超出执勤期限制

cards.audioText: They have revived the unconscious passenger by CPR procedure. It looks like he’ll be fine. Request to cancel the diversion.
cards.audioTextZh: 他们通过心肺复苏程序使失去知觉的乘客恢复了意识，他似乎情况转好，请求取消备降。（5-6级）

cards.audioText: Unable speed 180 knots. We need to maintain a good speed in clean configuration due icing.
cards.audioTextZh: 不能保持速度180节。由于积冰，我们需要在光洁构型下保持良好的速度

cards.audioText: Unable to reduce speed below mach decimal 74. You can vector us if you’d like.
cards.audioTextZh: 无法减速到马赫数.74。如果可以，你可以雷达引导我们

cards.audioText: Unable, an immediate right turn might not give us enough terrain clearance. Our turn radius is 4 miles at this speed.
cards.audioTextZh: 不行，立即右转可能导致越障阈度不够，当前速度的转弯半径是 4 海里

cards.audioText: Our aircraft has the required certification and is approved by your Civil Aviation Authority for scheduled flight.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们飞机有相应资质，你们民航当局也批准执行定期航班

title: 陆空通话
description: 结构 词汇 理解能力

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is QFA 432, you are parking at gate 24, you have got information H, ask Shanghai Delivery for ATC clearance to Beijing.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 QFA 432，停在 24 号登机口，已收到 H 情报，向上海放行申请前往北京的 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Delivery, QFA 432, gate 24, information H, request ATC clearance to Beijing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海放行，QFA 432，24 号登机口，收到 H 情报，申请前往北京的 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 432, cleared to Beijing via flight planned route, runway in use Runway 26, HZ-01 departure, initial climb to 600 meters on QNH, after departure, contact 128.75, squawk 3421.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 432，许可按飞行计划航路飞往北京，使用跑道 26，HZ-01 离场，QNH 上初始爬升至 600 米，离场后联系 128.75，应答机 3421。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Beijing via flight planned route, runway in use Runway 26, HZ-01 departure, initial climb to 600 meters on QNH, after departure, contact 128.75, squawk 3421, QFA 432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可按飞行计划航路飞往北京，使用跑道 26，HZ-01 离场，QNH 上初始爬升至 600 米，离场后联系 128.75，应答机 3421，QFA 432。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 432, read back correct, report when ready for push back and start up.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 432，复诵正确，准备好推出和开车时报告。
cards.referenceText: Wilco, QFA 432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 照办，QFA 432。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back and start up.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已准备好推出和开车。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Ground, QFA 432, ready for push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海地面，QFA 432，准备好推出和开车。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 432, push back and start up approved.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 432，推出和开车批准。
cards.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, QFA 432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 推出和开车批准，QFA 432。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready to taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已准备好滑行。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Ground, QFA 432, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海地面，QFA 432，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 432, taxi via taxiway F, C1 and B to holding point Runway 26. Caution! work in progress at the end of gate 319.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 432，经 F、C1 和 B 滑行道滑行至跑道 26 等待点。注意！319 号登机口末端有施工。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via taxiway F, C1 and B to holding point Runway 26, roger, thanks, QFA 432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 F、C1 和 B 滑行道滑行至跑道 26 等待点，收到，谢谢，QFA 432。

cards.audioText: B: As you are taxiing, you noticed some smoke coming from APU on Boeing 747 ahead of you, report this to ATC.
cards.audioTextZh: B：滑行时，你注意到前方 Boeing 747 的 APU 冒烟，向 ATC 报告。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Ground, QFA 432, we notice some smoke coming from APU on B747 ahead of us.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海地面，QFA 432，我们注意到前方 B747 的 APU 冒烟。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are holding point Runway 26, tell ATC you are ready for takeoff.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在跑道 26 等待点，告诉 ATC 你准备好起飞。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Tower, QFA 432, holding point Runway 26, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海塔台，QFA 432，跑道 26 等待点，准备好离场。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 432, behind landing traffic, line up behind.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 432，在落地航空器之后，跟随其后进跑道。
cards.referenceText: Behind landing traffic, line up behind, QFA 432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在落地航空器之后，跟随其后进跑道，QFA 432。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are reaching 5100 meters, contact Beijing Approach and request further descent.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你正到达 5100 米，联系北京进近并请求继续下降。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, QFA 432, reaching 5100 meters, request further descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，QFA 432，正到达 5100 米，请求继续下降。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 432, descend and maintain 3300 meters on QNH 1031.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 432，下降并保持 QNH 1031 上 3300 米。
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 3300 meters on QNH 1031, QFA 432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持 QNH 1031 上 3300 米，QFA 432。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are maintaining 3300 meters, request further descent.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你保持 3300 米，请求继续下降。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, QFA 432, maintaining 3300 meters, request further descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，QFA 432，保持 3300 米，请求继续下降。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 432, maintain 3300 meters, opposite traffic at 2 o'clock 10 miles, report clear of traffic.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 432，保持 3300 米，相对飞行航空器在 2 点钟方向 10 海里，脱离冲突后报告。
cards.referenceText: Maintain 3300 meters, wilco, QFA 432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持 3300 米，照办，QFA 432。

cards.audioText: B: Tell the controller you are clear of traffic and request further descent.
cards.audioTextZh: B：告诉管制员你已脱离该航空器，并请求下降。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, QFA 432, clear of traffic, request descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，QFA 432，已脱离航空器，请求下降。

cards.audioText: B: You are cleared to 1200 meters, the sky is turning dark, the visibility is deteriorating, you suspect a sandstorm, tell Beijing Approach the situation and ask ATC if there is sandstorm forecast.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你已获准下降至 1200 米，天空变暗，能见度变差，你怀疑有沙尘暴，告诉北京进近情况，并询问 ATC 是否有沙尘暴预报。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, QFA 432, descending to 1200 meters, the sky is turning dark, the visibility is deteriorating, we suspect a sandstorm, is there sandstorm forecast?
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，QFA 432，正下降至 1200 米，天空变暗，能见度变差，我们怀疑有沙尘暴，是否有沙尘暴预报？

cards.audioText: B: The sandstorm is severe and the visibility is very poor, inform ATC the situation, ask to climb to a higher level to get above the sandstorm.
cards.audioTextZh: B：沙尘暴严重，能见度很差，通知 ATC 情况，请求爬升到更高高度以避开沙尘暴上方。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, QFA 432, the sandstorm is severe and the visibility is very poor, request climb to a higher level.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，QFA 432，沙尘暴严重，能见度很差，请求爬升到更高高度。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 432, climb to 2100 meters, turn right heading 230.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 432，爬升至 2100 米，右转航向 230。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 2100 meters, turn right heading 230, QFA 432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升至 2100 米，右转航向 230，QFA 432。

cards.audioText: B: Your aircraft is Boeing 747, suddenly, number 1 number 2 engines have failed due to sandstorm, report it to Beijing Approach, ask if weather is clear in Beijing and request radar vector to Beijing for priority landing.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的飞机是 Boeing 747，突然，1 号和 2 号发动机因沙尘暴失效，向北京进近报告，请问北京天气是否晴朗，并请求雷达引导前往北京优先着陆。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Beijing Approach, QFA 432, No.1 and No.2 engines have failed due to sandstorm, request radar vector to Beijing for priority landing. Is weather in Beijing clear?
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，北京进近，QFA 432，1 号和 2 号发动机因沙尘暴失效，请求雷达引导前往北京优先着陆。北京天气晴朗吗？

cards.audioText: C: QFA 432, turn right heading 250, the weather in Beijing is clear.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 432，右转航向 250，北京天气晴朗。
cards.referenceText: Roger, turn right heading 250, QFA 432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，右转航向 250，QFA 432。

topics.name: QFA 160 燃油续航 导航定位

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is QFA 160, a flight from Tokyo to Guangzhou, you are maintaining 11000 meters, over WXI, your transponder code is 4525, make an initial contact with Zhengzhou Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 QFA 160，从东京飞往广州，保持 11000 米，飞越 WXI，应答机代码 4525，与郑州管制首次联系。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, QFA 160, maintaining 11000 meters, over WXI, squawking 4525.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州管制，QFA 160，保持 11000 米，飞越 WXI，应答机 4525。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 160, Zhengzhou Control, radar contact, descend and maintain 10400 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 160，郑州管制，雷达识别，下降并保持 10400 米。
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 10400 meters, QFA 160.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持 10400 米，QFA 160。

cards.audioText: B: You wish to know until what time you can expect high level, ask Zhengzhou Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你想知道什么时候可以预期高高度，询问郑州管制。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, QFA 160, until what time we can expect high level?
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州管制，QFA 160，我们什么时候可以预期高高度？

cards.audioText: C: QFA 160, Zhengzhou Control, you can expect further climb after passing ZHO, but for now, continue descent to 9200 meters, reduced to minimum speed due to temporary airways restriction.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 160，郑州管制，飞越 ZHO 后可预期继续爬升，但现在继续下降并保持 9200 米，因临时航路限制减至最小速度。
cards.referenceText: Roger, expect further climb after passing ZHO, continue descend and maintain 9200 meters, reduced to minimum speed, QFA 160.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，飞越 ZHO 后预期继续爬升，继续下降并保持 9200 米，减至最小速度，QFA 160。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 160, orbit right from present position until further advised.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 160，从当前位置右盘旋，直到进一步通知。
cards.referenceText: Orbit right from present position until further advised, QFA 160.
cards.referenceTextZh: 从当前位置右盘旋，直到进一步通知，QFA 160。

cards.audioText: B: After several orbits, you have calculated that if you hold any longer, the fuel on board will approach the required minimums, inform Zhengzhou Control about your situation.
cards.audioTextZh: B：几次盘旋后，你计算出如果继续等待，机上燃油将接近所需最低量，通知郑州管制你的情况。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, QFA 160, we will reach our minimum fuel if we are delayed any further.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州管制，QFA 160，如果再被延误，我们将达到最低燃油。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 160, Zhengzhou Control, roger, after this orbit, direct to AKOMA.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 160，郑州管制，收到，本次盘旋后，直飞 AKOMA。
cards.referenceText: After this orbit, direct to AKOMA, QFA 160.
cards.referenceTextZh: 本次盘旋后，直飞 AKOMA，QFA 160。

cards.audioText: B: Now you find you don't have enough fuel to fly to Guangzhou and you decide to divert to Changsha Airport, notify Zhengzhou Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你发现燃油不足以飞往广州，决定备降长沙机场，通知郑州管制。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, QFA 160, we don't have enough fuel to fly to Guangzhou, request divert to Changsha Airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州管制，QFA 160，我们没有足够燃油飞往广州，请求备降长沙机场。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 160, stand by for your request, temporary restriction is now cancelled, resume normal speed, direct to OBLIK.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 160，等待你的请求，临时限制现已取消，恢复正常速度，直飞 OBLIK。
cards.referenceText: Resume normal speed, direct to OBLIK, QFA 160.
cards.referenceTextZh: 恢复正常速度，直飞 OBLIK，QFA 160。

cards.audioText: B: You have a navigation system problem, your instrument is showing inaccurate position of your aircraft, notify Zhengzhou Control and ask for radar monitoring.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的导航系统有问题，仪表显示飞机位置不准确，通知郑州管制并请求雷达监控。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, QFA 160, we have a navigation system problem, our instrument is showing inaccurate position, request radar monitoring.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州管制，QFA 160，我们有导航系统问题，仪表显示位置不准确，请求雷达监控。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 160, roger, you are slightly deviating to the left, turn right 5 degrees, contact Wuhan Control on 134.7, request diversion from Wuhan Control.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 160，收到，你稍微向左偏航，右转 5 度，联系武汉管制134.7，向武汉管制请求备降。
cards.referenceText: Roger, turn right 5 degrees, 134.7, QFA 160.

cards.audioText: B: Now you are maintaining 9200 meters, over OBLIK, squawking 4525, contact Wuhan Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你保持 9200 米，飞越 OBLIK，应答机 4525，联系武汉管制。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, QFA 160, maintaining 9200 meters, over OBLIK, squawking 4525.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，QFA 160，保持 9200 米，飞越 OBLIK，应答机 4525。

cards.audioText:
C: QFA 160, Wuhan Control, radar contact, I understand you have a navigation problem and fuel shortage, confirm you are diverting to Changsha.
B: Tell Wuhan Control you are performing the checklist and tell Wuhan Control to stand by.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：QFA 160，武汉管制，雷达识别，我了解你有导航问题和燃油不足，确认你正在备降长沙。
B：告诉武汉管制你正在执行检查单，并让武汉管制稍等。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, QFA 160, stand by, we are performing the checklist.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，QFA 160，请稍等，我们正在执行检查单。

cards.audioText: B: Inform Wuhan Control you are flying with basic navigation instruments and you want to change your alternate airport to Wuhan Airport.
cards.audioTextZh: B：通知武汉管制你正在使用基本导航仪表飞行，并希望将备降机场改为武汉机场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, QFA 160, we are flying with basic navigation instruments, request divert to Wuhan Airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，QFA 160，我们正在使用基本导航仪表飞行，请求备降武汉机场。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 160, roger, divert to Wuhan approved, descend and maintain 4800 meters, contact Wuhan Approach on 120.45 when reaching.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 160，收到，备降武汉批准，下降并保持 4800 米，到达时联系武汉进近120.45。
cards.referenceText: Divert to Wuhan approved, descend and maintain 4800 meters, 120.45, QFA 160.
cards.referenceTextZh: 备降武汉批准，下降并保持 4800 米，120.45，QFA 160。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are reaching 4800 meters, you have got information B, make an initial contact with Wuhan Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你正到达 4800 米，已收到 B 情报，与武汉进近首次联系。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, QFA 160, reaching 4800 meters, information B.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，QFA 160，正到达 4800 米，收到 B 情报。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 160, Wuhan Approach, radar contact, information B is current, follow ZF-01A arrival, expect ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 160，武汉进近，雷达识别，B 情报有效，执行 ZF-01A 进场，预期 ILS 进近跑道 36 右。
cards.referenceText: Follow ZF-01A arrival, expect ILS approach Runway 36R, QFA 160.
cards.referenceTextZh: 执行 ZF-01A 进场，预期 ILS 进近跑道 36R，QFA 160。

cards.audioText:
C: QFA 160, are you declaring fuel emergency?
B: Inform the controller that you still have more than 2 hours fuel endurance and you are not declaring a fuel emergency.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：QFA 160，你是否宣布燃油紧急？
B：通知管制员你仍有超过 2 小时续航燃油，并且不宣布燃油紧急。
cards.referenceText: Negative, we still have more than 2 hours fuel endurance, QFA 160
cards.referenceTextZh: 否定，我们仍有超过 2 小时续航燃油，QFA 160。

topics.name: QFA 923 乘客，滑行道包裹 液压失效

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is QFA 923, you are near departure time, however 1 passenger is missing while his checked luggage is still on board, for security reasons, contact Company operations to offload the baggage.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 QFA 923，接近离场时间，但有 1 名旅客未到而其托运行李仍在机上。出于安全原因，联系公司运行卸下行李。
cards.referenceText: Dispatch, QFA 923, we are near departure time, 1 passenger is missing, but his checked luggage is still on board, request offload the baggage.
cards.referenceTextZh: 签派，QFA 923，我们接近离场时间，1 名旅客未到，但他的托运行李仍在机上，请求卸下行李。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are at gate 51, you have got information W, request ATC clearance to Los Angeles.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在 51 号登机口，已收到 W 情报，请求前往洛杉矶的 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, QFA 923, gate 51, information W, request ATC clearance to Los Angeles.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，QFA 923，51 号登机口，收到 W 情报，申请前往洛杉矶的 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 923, cleared to Los Angeles via flight planned route, Runway 36R, LKO-01 departure, initial climb 1500 meters, cruising level 9800 meters, after departure, contact 119.7, squawk 2515.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 923，许可按飞行计划航路飞往洛杉矶，跑道 36 右，LKO-01 离场，初始爬升 1500 米，巡航高度 9800 米，离场后联系 119.7，应答机 2515。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Los Angeles via flight planned route, Runway 36R, LKO-01 departure, initial climb 1500 meters, cruising level 9800 meters, after departure, contact 119.7, squawk 2515, QFA 923.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可按飞行计划航路飞往洛杉矶，跑道 36R，LKO-01 离场，初始爬升 1500 米，巡航高度 9800 米，离场后联系 119.7，应答机 2515，QFA 923。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 923, expect 10 minutes delay due taxiway A3 is temporarily blocked by a broken down vehicle.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 923，预计延误 10 分钟，因 A3 滑行道被一辆故障车辆临时阻塞。
cards.referenceText: Roger, QFA 923.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，QFA 923。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 923, monitor Ground 119.35.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 923，守听地面 119.35。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back and start up.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你准备好推出和开车。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, QFA 923, ready for push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，QFA 923，准备好推出和开车。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 923, there is a Citation next to you being pushed, once the aircraft is clear, push back onto Z4, abeam gate 213, facing east.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 923，你旁边有一架 Citation 正在推出，该机离开后，推出至 Z4，正对 213 号登机口，机头向东。
cards.referenceText: Roger, once Citation is clear, push back onto Z4, abeam gate 213, facing east, QFA 923.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，Citation 离开后，推出至 Z4，正对 213 号登机口，机头向东，QFA 923。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你准备好滑行。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, QFA 923, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，QFA 923，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 923, taxi via taxiway Z4, A3 and A to holding point Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 923，经 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行道滑行至跑道 36 右等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via taxiway Z4, A3 and A to holding point Runway 36R, QFA 923.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行道滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，QFA 923。

cards.audioText: B: As you are taxiing on taxiway A3, you notice several baggage are scattered on A3, about 400 meters ahead of your aircraft, tell Ground control why you have stopped taxiing and ask ground services to retrieve the baggage.
cards.audioTextZh: B：当你在 A3 滑行道滑行时，注意到数件行李散落在 A3，约在飞机前方 400 米处。告诉地面管制你为何停止滑行，并请求地面服务取回行李。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, QFA 923, we notice several baggage are scattered on A3, about 400 meters ahead, we have stopped taxiing, request ground services to retrieve/remove the baggage.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，QFA 923，我们注意到数件行李散落在 A3，约前方 400 米，我们已停止滑行，请求地面服务取回/移除行李。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 923, hold position, we have notified the ground handling department.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 923，保持位置，我们已通知地面保障部门。
cards.referenceText: Hold position, roger, thanks, QFA 923.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持位置，收到，谢谢，QFA 923。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 923, taxiway A3 is clear, expedite taxi via taxiway A3 and A to holding point Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 923，A3 滑行道已畅通，经 A3 和 A 滑行道加速滑行至跑道 36 右等待点。
cards.referenceText: Roger, expedite taxi via taxiway A3 and A to holding point Runway 36R, QFA 923.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，经 A3 和 A 滑行道加速滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，QFA 923。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are airborne, leaving 1200 meters for 2400 meters, contact Wuhan Departure and request further climb.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已离地，离开 1200 米爬升至 2400 米，联系武汉离场并请求继续爬升。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, QFA 923, leaving 1200 meters for 2400 meters, request further climb.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，QFA 923，离开 1200 米爬升至 2400 米，请求继续爬升。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 923, Wuhan Departure, radar contact, expedite climb to 6000 meters due crossing traffic.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 923，武汉离场，雷达识别，因穿越航空器，加速爬升至 6000 米。
cards.referenceText: Roger, expedite climb to 6000 meters, QFA 923.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，加速爬升至 6000 米，QFA 923。

cards.audioText: B: During climbing, 1 of your hydraulic systems has failed, make an Urgency call and ask to level off at 4500 meters and then return to land at Wuhan Airport.
cards.audioTextZh: B：爬升过程中，你的 1 套液压系统失效，发出紧急呼叫，请求在 4500 米改平，然后返回武汉机场着陆。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Approach, QFA 923, 1 of our hydraulic systems has failed, request level off at 4500 meters and return to land at Wuhan Airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉进近，QFA 923，我们 1 套液压系统失效，请求在 4500 米改平并返回武汉机场着陆。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 923, climb and maintain 4500 meters, turn left, track direct to LKO, expect LKO-02A arrival, ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 923，爬升并保持 4500 米，左转，直飞 LKO，预期 LKO-02A 进场，ILS 进近跑道 36 右。
cards.referenceText: Climb and maintain 4500 meters, turn left, track direct to LKO, expect LKO-02A arrival, ILS approach Runway 36R, QFA 923.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持 4500 米，左转，直飞 LKO，预期 LKO-02A 进场，ILS 进近跑道 36R，QFA 923。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 923, descend to 2700 meters on QNH 1012.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 923，下降至 QNH 1012 上 2700 米。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 2700 meters on QNH 1012, QFA 923.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降至 QNH 1012 上 2700 米，QFA 923。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 923, contact Wuhan Tower 124.35.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 923，联系武汉塔台124.35。

cards.audioText: B: The purser informs you that a passenger has become ill, possibly suffering from hyperventilation, ask for an ambulance to wait at the gate.
cards.audioTextZh: B：乘务长通知你有一名旅客生病，可能过度换气，请求救护车在登机口等待。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, QFA 923, a passenger has become ill, possibly suffering from hyperventilation, request an ambulance to wait at the gate.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，QFA 923，有一名旅客生病，可能过度换气，请求救护车在登机口等待。

title: OPI
description: 发音 结构 词汇 流利度 理解能力 应对能力

cards.audioText: Have you ever encountered a lightning strike during flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在飞行中遇到过雷击吗？
cards.referenceText: No, I have never encountered a lightning strike during flight. I know that lightning strikes are dangerous, so I avoid them during flight.
cards.referenceTextZh: 没有，我在飞行中从未遭遇过雷击。我知道雷击很危险，因此在飞行中会避开雷电活动区域。

cards.audioText: Under what weather conditions are lightning strikes most likely to occur?
cards.audioTextZh: 雷击最可能在哪些天气条件下发生？
cards.referenceText: Lightning strikes are most likely to occur in thunderstorms or cumulonimbus clouds.
cards.referenceTextZh: 雷击最可能发生在雷暴或积雨云中。

cards.audioText: Why are lightning strikes hazardous to flight safety?
cards.audioTextZh: 为什么雷击会危及飞行安全？
cards.referenceText: A lightning strike may damage the fuselage, wings, or electronic equipment. It may also cause electrical failure or disrupt communication and navigation systems.
cards.referenceTextZh: 雷击可能损坏机身、机翼或电子设备，还可能导致电气故障，或使通信和导航系统中断。

cards.audioText: What should a pilot do if the aircraft is struck by lightning during flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行中飞机遭遇雷击时，飞行员应如何处置？
cards.referenceText: I would first maintain control of the aircraft and follow the SOP and checklist. I would check for structural or system damage and report the situation to ATC. If the damage were severe, I would request a diversion to an alternate airport. After landing, I would request a maintenance inspection.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我会首先控制好飞机，并遵循标准操作程序和检查单。我会检查飞机是否存在结构或系统损伤，并向空中交通管制报告情况。如果损伤严重，我会申请改航至备降机场。着陆后，我会申请进行维修检查。

cards.audioText: What measures can pilots take to reduce the risk of a lightning strike?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员可以采取哪些措施降低遭遇雷击的风险？
cards.referenceText: Before flight, I check the weather reports and avoid areas where lightning is likely. During flight, I monitor the weather radar and request a deviation from ATC if lightning is detected ahead. I also avoid cumulonimbus clouds and thunderstorm areas.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行前，我会查看天气报告，并避开可能发生雷电的区域。飞行中，我会监控气象雷达；如果前方探测到雷电，就向空中交通管制申请绕飞。我还会避开积雨云和雷暴区域。

cards.audioText: What damage can a lightning strike cause to an aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh: 雷击会对飞机造成哪些损伤？
cards.referenceText: A lightning strike may damage the fuselage, wings, or electronic equipment. It may also cause communication or navigation failure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 雷击可能损坏机身、机翼或电子设备，还可能导致通信或导航失效。

cards.audioText: During which phase of flight is an aircraft most likely to be struck by lightning?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞机在哪个飞行阶段最容易遭遇雷击？
cards.referenceText: An aircraft is most likely to be struck by lightning during climb, descent, or holding rather than at normal cruise altitude. These phases often take it through active cloud layers at lower altitudes. The risk is greatest near thunderstorms and at levels where the temperature is close to freezing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞机在爬升、下降或等待阶段比在正常巡航高度更容易遭到雷击，因为这些阶段常会穿过较低高度的活跃云层。雷暴附近以及温度接近冰点的高度层风险最大。

cards.audioText: Have you ever encountered icing conditions during flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在飞行中遇到过结冰条件吗？
cards.referenceText: No, I have never encountered in-flight icing. I know that icing can affect aircraft performance, so I try to avoid icing conditions during flight.
cards.referenceTextZh: 没有，我从未在飞行中遇到过结冰。我知道结冰会影响飞机性能，因此会尽量避开结冰条件。

cards.audioText: What cockpit or other indications can alert pilots to airframe icing?
cards.audioTextZh: 哪些驾驶舱指示或其他迹象可以提醒飞行员机体结冰？
cards.referenceText: Pilots may see ice building up on the windshield or wings. Reduced airspeed, changes in altitude or climb performance, and reports from ATC or other pilots can also provide warning. Some large aircraft have ice detectors that give a direct indication.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行员可能看到风挡或机翼上开始积冰。空速下降、高度或爬升性能变化，以及空中交通管制或其他飞行员的报告，也能提供警示。一些大型飞机装有可直接提供指示的结冰探测器。

cards.audioText: How can in-flight icing affect flight safety?
cards.audioTextZh: 空中结冰会如何影响飞行安全？
cards.referenceText: In-flight icing may reduce lift, increase drag, and cause flight-control problems or a stall. It may also cause incorrect airspeed or altitude indications and may lead to engine vibration, flameout, or failure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行中结冰会减小升力、增大阻力，并可能导致飞行操纵问题或失速。它还可能造成空速或高度指示错误，并可能引起发动机振动、熄火或失效。

cards.audioText: What should pilots do if they encounter icing conditions in flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行中遇到结冰条件时，飞行员应如何处置？
cards.referenceText: I would turn on the pitot heating system, advise ATC of the situation, and request a route or flight-level change to avoid the icing conditions.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我会打开空速管加温系统，向空中交通管制报告情况，并申请改变航路或飞行高度层，以避开结冰条件。

cards.audioText: What should a pilot do if ice begins to accumulate on the wings in flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行中机翼开始积冰时，飞行员应如何处置？
cards.referenceText: I would report the situation to ATC and request an altitude change to leave the icing area. I would also turn on the aircraft's de-icing and anti-icing systems.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我会向空中交通管制报告情况，并申请改变高度以离开结冰区域。我还会打开飞机的除冰和防冰系统。

cards.audioText: Under what atmospheric conditions is aircraft icing likely to occur?
cards.audioTextZh: 哪些大气条件下容易发生飞机结冰？
cards.referenceText: Aircraft icing is likely when the air and aircraft surface temperatures are below 0°C and there are enough supercooled droplets in the air. It is more likely in cold, humid conditions.
cards.referenceTextZh: 当空气和飞机表面温度低于 0°C，且空气中有足够多的过冷水滴时，飞机容易结冰。寒冷潮湿条件下更容易发生结冰。

cards.audioText: On which parts of an aircraft is ice most likely to form?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞机哪些部位最容易结冰？
cards.referenceText: Ice is most likely to form on exposed leading edges and critical components. These include the wings, windshield, engine air intakes, pitot tubes, static ports, radio antennas, and landing gear.
cards.referenceTextZh: 冰最容易积聚在暴露的前缘和关键部件上，包括机翼、风挡、发动机进气口、空速管、静压孔、无线电天线和起落架。

cards.audioText: What de-icing systems are installed on the aircraft you fly?
cards.audioTextZh: 你所飞的飞机安装了哪些除冰系统？
cards.referenceText: The aircraft I fly uses hot air, electrical heating, and de-icing fluid for ice protection.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我所飞的飞机使用热空气、电加温和除冰液进行防冰保护。

cards.audioText: How does an aircraft's anti-icing system work?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞机的防冰系统如何工作？
cards.referenceText: An aircraft anti-icing system uses electrical power or hot engine bleed air to heat critical surfaces. These may include the windshield, pitot tubes, wing leading edges, and engine intakes. The heat prevents ice from building up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞机防冰系统利用电力或发动机热引气加热关键表面。这些表面可能包括风挡、空速管、机翼前缘和发动机进气口。加热可以防止冰层积聚。

cards.audioText: What types of airframe ice can form in flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行中可能形成哪些类型的机体积冰？
cards.referenceText: The common types of airframe ice are rime ice, clear ice, and mixed ice.
cards.referenceTextZh: 常见的机体积冰类型包括雾凇冰、明冰和混合冰。

cards.audioText: Which type of airframe ice poses the greatest threat to flight safety, and why?
cards.audioTextZh: 哪种类型的机体积冰对飞行安全威胁最大？为什么？
cards.referenceText: Clear ice poses the greatest threat. It can form a smooth, hard layer that changes the aerodynamic shape, is difficult to remove, and can accumulate quickly. This may lead to a loss of lift and control.
cards.referenceTextZh: 明冰的威胁最大。它会形成光滑坚硬的冰层，改变气动外形，难以清除，而且可能迅速积聚。这可能导致升力和操纵能力丧失。

cards.audioText: What is the difference between de-icing and anti-icing?
cards.audioTextZh: 除冰与防冰有什么区别？
cards.referenceText: De-icing removes ice, snow, or frost that has already accumulated on an aircraft. Anti-icing helps prevent new ice from forming after de-icing. Many operations use de-icing first and anti-icing second.
cards.referenceTextZh: 除冰是清除已经积聚在飞机上的冰、雪或霜。防冰则是在除冰后帮助防止新的冰层形成。许多运行先除冰，随后再进行防冰。

cards.audioText: What is holdover time in ground de-icing and anti-icing operations?
cards.audioTextZh: 在地面除冰和防冰作业中，什么是保持时间？
cards.referenceText: Holdover time is the estimated period during which anti-icing fluid protects an aircraft from ice, snow, or frost accumulation. It begins when the final anti-icing application starts and ends when the fluid loses effectiveness. It depends on the fluid type, weather, and precipitation intensity; if it expires before takeoff, new contamination may form and re-treatment may be needed.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持时间是指防冰液保护飞机免受冰、雪或霜积聚的预计时段。它从最后一次防冰液喷洒开始时计算，到防冰液失效时结束。保持时间取决于液体类型、天气和降水强度；如果起飞前超过保持时间，可能再次形成污染，需要重新处理。

cards.audioText: Why must an aircraft take off within the applicable holdover time after ground de-icing or anti-icing?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞机在地面除冰或防冰后，为什么必须在适用的保持时间内起飞？
cards.referenceText: Anti-icing fluid loses effectiveness over time. If takeoff is delayed beyond the applicable holdover time, ice, snow, or frost may accumulate again on critical surfaces. This contamination can reduce lift and increase drag, so the aircraft must be treated again before takeoff.
cards.referenceTextZh: 防冰液的有效性会随时间下降。如果起飞延误并超过适用的保持时间，冰、雪或霜可能再次积聚在关键表面上。这种污染会减小升力并增大阻力，因此飞机必须在起飞前重新进行除防冰处理。

cards.audioText: What are the common types of aircraft de-icing and anti-icing fluids?
cards.audioTextZh: 常见的飞机除冰液和防冰液有哪些类型？
cards.referenceText: The four common fluid categories are Type I, Type II, Type III, and Type IV.
cards.referenceTextZh: 常见的四类液体是 I 型、II 型、III 型和 IV 型。

cards.audioText: How do the common types of aircraft de-icing and anti-icing fluids differ?
cards.audioTextZh: 常见类型的飞机除冰液和防冰液有何区别？
cards.referenceText: Type I is a thin, heated de-icing fluid that runs off quickly and provides a short holdover time. Type II is thicker and remains on the surface longer, while Type III is designed for smaller aircraft. Type IV is very thick and provides the longest holdover time.
cards.referenceTextZh: I 型是黏度较低的加热除冰液，会很快流走，保持时间较短。II 型黏度更高，在表面停留时间更长；III 型适用于较小型飞机。IV 型黏度很高，保持时间最长。

cards.audioText: Who is responsible for deciding whether de-icing or anti-icing is needed before takeoff?
cards.audioTextZh: 起飞前由谁负责决定是否需要除冰或防冰？
cards.referenceText: The pilot in command has final responsibility for deciding whether de-icing or anti-icing is required. The pilot should assess the weather and any contamination and may consult dispatch and ground de-icing personnel for technical advice. The final decision remains with the captain.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是否需要除冰或防冰，最终由机长负责决定。机长应评估天气和任何污染情况，并可向签派和地面除冰人员征询技术意见。最终决定仍由机长作出。

cards.audioText: How should the appropriate de-icing or anti-icing fluid be selected in heavy snow?
cards.audioTextZh: 大雪条件下应如何选择合适的除冰液或防冰液？
cards.referenceText: In heavy snow, a two-step process may use heated Type I fluid to remove existing contamination, followed by Type IV fluid for anti-icing. The crew should check the fluid's certified weather conditions.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在大雪条件下，两步法可以先使用加热的 I 型液体清除已有污染，再使用 IV 型液体进行防冰。机组应核对该液体获准使用的天气条件。

cards.audioText: What is wind shear?
cards.audioTextZh: 什么是风切变？
cards.referenceText: Wind shear is a sudden change in wind speed or direction over a short distance or within a small area. It can cause rapid changes in aircraft airspeed and altitude.
cards.referenceTextZh: 风切变是风速或风向在很短距离或很小区域内突然发生变化。它会使飞机空速和高度迅速改变。

cards.audioText: Where is wind shear most likely to occur?
cards.audioTextZh: 风切变最可能在哪里发生？
cards.referenceText: Wind shear is most likely near thunderstorms and convective cells, especially close to the ground where microbursts can affect takeoff and approach. It can also occur near frontal weather and strong changes in surface wind. Low-level wind shear is particularly dangerous because there is little height available for recovery.
cards.referenceTextZh: 风切变最容易发生在雷暴和强对流单体附近，尤其在接近地面的区域，微下击暴流会影响起飞和进近。它也可能出现在锋面天气和地面风发生强烈变化的区域。低空风切变特别危险，因为可用于改出的高度很少。

cards.audioText: Have you ever received a wind shear warning in flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在飞行中收到过风切变警告吗？
cards.referenceText: No, I have never received a wind shear warning in flight. I fly a DA-40 for flight training, and that aircraft does not have a wind shear warning system.
cards.referenceTextZh: 没有，我在飞行中从未收到过风切变警告。我使用 DA-40 进行飞行训练，这种飞机没有风切变警告系统。

cards.audioText: What are the possible consequences if a pilot ignores a wind shear warning?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果飞行员忽视风切变警告，可能会造成哪些后果？
cards.referenceText: If a pilot ignores a wind shear warning, the aircraft may experience sudden airspeed and altitude changes. It may become difficult to control and could stall or crash.
cards.referenceTextZh: 如果飞行员忽视风切变警告，飞机的空速和高度可能突然变化。飞机可能变得难以操纵，并可能失速或坠毁。

cards.audioText: How are pilots warned about wind shear on your aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh: 你所飞的飞机通过什么方式向飞行员发出风切变警告？
cards.referenceText: The DA-40 I fly does not have a wind shear warning system. On large commercial aircraft, weather radar and EGPWS can provide a wind shear warning to the pilots.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我飞的 DA-40 没有风切变警告系统。在大型商用飞机上，气象雷达和 EGPWS 可以向飞行员提供风切变警告。

cards.audioText: Why is wind shear a threat to flight safety?
cards.audioTextZh: 为什么风切变会威胁飞行安全？
cards.referenceText: Wind shear can cause sudden increases or decreases in airspeed and a rapid loss of altitude. The aircraft may become difficult to control, stall, or crash.
cards.referenceTextZh: 风切变会使空速突然增大或减小，并造成高度迅速下降。飞机可能变得难以操纵、失速，甚至坠毁。

cards.audioText: Have you ever encountered wind shear in flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在飞行中遇到过风切变吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I once encountered wind shear during a training flight. The aircraft's speed and altitude changed abruptly. I maintained control, communicated with ATC, and adjusted the flight parameters to recover from the situation.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我曾在一次训练飞行中遭遇风切变。飞机的速度和高度突然变化。我控制好飞机，与空中交通管制沟通，并调整飞行参数，使飞机恢复正常状态。

cards.audioText: What should pilots do if they hear a "GO-AROUND, WINDSHEAR AHEAD" warning during approach?
cards.audioTextZh: 进近过程中听到“复飞，前方风切变”警告时，飞行员应如何处置？
cards.referenceText: The pilots should go around immediately. They should use TOGA thrust, maintain the required configuration until clear of the wind shear, and closely monitor airspeed, altitude, attitude, and vertical speed.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行员应立即复飞。他们应使用 TOGA 推力，在脱离风切变之前保持规定的构型，并密切监控空速、高度、姿态和垂直速度。

cards.audioText: What should pilots do if they encounter wind shear during the takeoff roll before V1?
cards.audioTextZh: 在 V1 前的起飞滑跑阶段遇到风切变时，飞行员应如何处置？
cards.referenceText: Before V1, the pilots should reject the takeoff by reducing power, using rudder to keep the aircraft straight, and applying the brakes to stop on the runway.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在 V1 之前，飞行员应减小推力，使用方向舵保持飞机直线，并使用刹车使飞机停在跑道上，从而中断起飞。

cards.audioText: What would you do if you encountered wind shear and a sudden loss of airspeed as the aircraft approached rotation speed?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞机接近抬前轮速度时，如果遭遇风切变并且空速突然下降，你会如何处置？
cards.referenceText: If the event were recognized before the takeoff decision speed and a safe rejection could be initiated, I would maintain directional control and reject the takeoff in accordance with the procedure. At or after the decision speed, I would continue, rotate normally at the calculated rotation speed, and follow the wind-shear escape guidance. I would avoid configuration changes until the aircraft was clear of the shear.
cards.referenceTextZh: 如果在起飞决断速度之前识别到该情况，并且能够安全中断起飞，我会保持方向控制并按照程序中断起飞。在达到或超过决断速度后，我会继续起飞，按计算的抬轮速度正常抬轮，并遵循风切变逃逸指引。在飞机脱离风切变之前，我会避免改变构型。

cards.audioText: How can wind shear cause an aircraft to deviate from the glide slope during approach?
cards.audioTextZh: 进近过程中，风切变如何导致飞机偏离下滑道？
cards.referenceText: A sudden increase in headwind can raise indicated airspeed and lift, causing the aircraft to move above the glide slope. A downdraft or a change to tailwind can reduce airspeed and lift and push it below the glide slope. Because these changes can occur quickly, large corrections may make the approach unstable.
cards.referenceTextZh: 顶风突然增强会使指示空速和升力增大，导致飞机高于下滑道。下沉气流或变为顺风会使空速和升力减小，并将飞机推至下滑道以下。由于这些变化可能迅速发生，过大的修正会使进近变得不稳定。

cards.audioText: Why is low-level wind shear more hazardous than wind shear at higher altitudes?
cards.audioTextZh: 为什么低空风切变比高空风切变更危险？
cards.referenceText: Low-level wind shear occurs close to the ground, often during takeoff, climb, approach, or landing. A sudden loss of airspeed or altitude leaves less time and height for recovery, and nearby terrain or buildings may be difficult to clear.
cards.referenceTextZh: 低空风切变发生在接近地面的区域，通常出现在起飞、爬升、进近或着陆阶段。空速或高度突然下降会使飞行员用于改出的时间和高度更少，附近地形或建筑物也可能难以越过。

cards.audioText: How should pilots respond to a wind shear warning in flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行中收到风切变警告时，飞行员应如何处置？
cards.referenceText: During takeoff, the pilots should maintain control, add power, and leave the wind shear area. During landing, they should go around.
cards.referenceTextZh: 起飞过程中，飞行员应控制好飞机，增加推力并离开风切变区域。着陆过程中则应复飞。

cards.audioText: What should pilots do if they encounter wind shear during takeoff?
cards.audioTextZh: 起飞过程中遇到风切变时，飞行员应如何处置？
cards.referenceText: If wind shear is encountered before V1, the pilots should not continue the takeoff. If it is encountered after V1, they should maintain aircraft control, add power, and leave the wind shear area.
cards.referenceTextZh: 如果在 V1 之前遭遇风切变，飞行员不应继续起飞。如果在 V1 之后遭遇，应控制好飞机，增加推力并离开风切变区域。

cards.audioText: How can wind shear affect aircraft performance?
cards.audioTextZh: 风切变会如何影响飞机性能？
cards.referenceText: Wind shear may cause the aircraft's airspeed to increase or decrease, and it may cause a loss of altitude.
cards.referenceTextZh: 风切变可能使飞机空速增大或减小，也可能造成高度损失。

cards.audioText: What would you do if low-level wind shear were forecast for takeoff?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果预报起飞时会出现低空风切变，你会如何处置？
cards.referenceText: If low-level wind shear were forecast before takeoff, I would delay the takeoff or change to another runway.
cards.referenceTextZh: 如果起飞前预报有低空风切变，我会推迟起飞或改用另一条跑道。

cards.audioText: How can pilots recognize that they have encountered wind shear?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员如何判断飞机已经遭遇风切变？
cards.referenceText: Pilots may recognize wind shear from sudden changes in airspeed, ground speed, or vertical speed.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行员可以通过空速、地速或垂直速度突然变化来识别风切变。

cards.audioText: What measures can help reduce accidents caused by wind shear?
cards.audioTextZh: 哪些措施有助于减少风切变造成的事故？
cards.referenceText: Pilots can check forecasts, ATIS, and NOTAMs before flight and avoid takeoff or landing in areas affected by wind shear. In flight, they can use weather radar and pilot reports and monitor wind changes. Training, predictive wind shear systems, and timely ATC alerts also help reduce accidents.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行员可以在飞行前查看预报、ATIS 和航行通告，并避免在受风切变影响的区域起飞或着陆。飞行中可以利用气象雷达和飞行员报告，并监控风的变化。训练、预测式风切变系统以及空中交通管制及时发出的警告也有助于减少事故。

cards.audioText: During which seasons is wind shear most likely to occur?
cards.audioTextZh: 哪些季节最容易出现风切变？
cards.referenceText: The season depends on the local climate, so there is no single answer worldwide. Convective wind shear is most likely during the local thunderstorm season, while frontal and inversion-related wind shear can occur at other times. Pilots should use current forecasts, reports, and local weather patterns rather than relying only on the time of year.
cards.referenceTextZh: 具体季节取决于当地气候，因此全球没有统一答案。对流性风切变最常见于当地雷暴季节，而锋面或逆温相关的风切变也可能在其他时段发生。飞行员应依据当前预报、报告和当地天气规律，而不能只看季节。

cards.audioText: AFR123 crashed at Singapore Changi Airport during takeoff. The tower controller instructed the crew to takeoff on Runway 02L, but the crew lined up runway 02R and began their takeoff rolling. The aircraft overran the runway and crashed. Crew members and 110 passengers were killed, and the co-pilot was badly wounded. According to the investigation, there were three reasons for the accidents. First of all, the crew didn't use effective methods to verify their position. Secondly, the crew forgot to check whether they were on the correct runway or not. Finally, the crew members' idle chatting during the taxi resulted the loss of situation awareness.
cards.audioTextZh: AFR123在新加坡樟宜机场起飞期间坠毁。塔台管制员指示机组从02L跑道起飞，但机组却在02R跑道对正并开始起飞滑跑。飞机冲出跑道并坠毁。机组成员和110名乘客遇难，副驾驶严重受伤。调查显示，这起事故有三个原因。首先，机组没有采用有效方法确认自己所在的位置。其次，机组忘记检查自己是否位于正确的跑道。最后，机组成员在滑行期间闲聊，导致情景意识丧失。

cards.audioText: An A320 collided with a B737 during taxi. The right ailerons of B737 was severely damaged but A320 only had minor damage on left wing. Luckily, there were no injuries. After receiving taxi instruction, the A320 began to pass the B737 from the right side. The captain of A320 thought they had enough room. But unfortunately, two aircraft collided together. Both captains reported the collision immediately. Because the Boeing aircraft was damaged seriously, fuel leakage was reported and fire services were required. Fortunately, the fuel leak didn't develop into fire. The crew of the Boeing aircraft complained that they just parked stationary with the parking brakes when they were hit.
cards.audioTextZh: 一架A320在滑行期间与一架B737相撞。B737的右副翼严重受损，而A320的左翼仅轻微受损。幸运的是，没有人员受伤。收到滑行指令后，A320开始从B737右侧通过。A320机长认为有足够空间可以通过，但两架飞机不幸发生碰撞。两位机长立即报告了相撞情况。由于波音飞机受损严重，机组报告发生燃油泄漏并请求消防救援。幸运的是，泄漏的燃油没有起火。波音飞机机组表示，他们被撞时一直设置着停留刹车，停在原地。

cards.audioText: A pilot of Air China airline told us an event with landing gear problem. After normal push-back, start-up and taxi, he requested takeoff. However, he was instructed to hold short of the runway in order to give way to ACA702 on final. ACA702 declared emergency because of landing gear problem. ACA702 asked for a low pass. The controller verified the landing gear was still in up position. Then ACA702 requested a touch and go to jar the jammed gear. Unfortunately, the landing gear still couldn't be extended. So, ACA702 had to make a belly landing on a foamed runway. There were no casualties except some minor injuries.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航的一名飞行员告诉了我们一起关于起落架问题的事件。在正常的推出、开车和滑行后，他请求起飞。然而，他被指示在跑道外等待，以便给五边的ACA702让路。不过，ACA702因为起落架问题宣布进入紧急状态，并且请求低空通场，管制员证实起落架仍在收上位。然后ACA702请求飞一个连续起飞去把起落架震动下来。但是，起落架仍然没放下来。因此，ACA702必须要做一个机腹着陆，并且跑道要铺泡沫。除了一些人员受到轻伤外，没有人员伤亡。
